_note: Canonical animation-name → sprite map for ClaudeTeam-M01-Dev (v3 92x92 persona). PixelLab does NOT export the semantic animation_name; its metadata.json keys by an action-description slug + folder. This file is the authoritative map the webview trigger logic + manifest generator (scripts/build-sprite-manifest.mjs) consume. VALUE FORMAT: a bare folder name `<state_folder>` means that folder holds exactly ONE animation (resolve animations/<sole-slug>/south/frame_*.png); a `<state_folder>/<anim_slug>` value names a SPECIFIC animation inside a folder holding MORE THAN ONE. active_work + active_read SHARE the Sitting_at_a_desk_wo desk state (state b73d5b2e — same desk posture → no flip during active sessions), so both use the folder/slug form. idle_pool = [idle_coffee, idle_stretch, idle_think] (webview picks at random). active_pool = [active_work] — a single-member pool (ticket 86ca5ftzp) so `pickActive` always returns active_work, keeping the dashboard pose identical to a no-pool char while enabling the tuner's Active-pool Source / Prev-Next / Cycle-over-room controls. active_read stays tool==Read-gated (NEVER pool-drawn). Slugs discovered from the harvested metadata.json — not guessed.
_render_note: Per-character render-fit (ticket 86ca5b0gj). v3 92x92 sprites bake the figure into only ~50% of the canvas (measured: figure ~46-51px of 92px, ~20-24px transparent bottom margin) vs ~75% for the legacy 68x68 chars (F01/M01/M02). With `.sprite-frame { object-fit: contain }` the WHOLE canvas scales into the box, so a 92px char renders ~0.7x the apparent figure size AND floats high. `scale` enlarges the figure to the 68px apparent size; `offsetY` (% of box, positive = DOWN/forward toward the viewer) fine-anchors it. Origin is center-center: scale 1.5 lands the feet at ~86% down, matching the 68px chars. SPONSOR-TUNABLE on reload (edit + npm run build + reload, OR override the dashboard.css :root --ct-render-scale / --ct-render-offset-y fallbacks for a no-rebuild nudge). Omit the block to render identity (no transform).
_playback_note: Per-animation playback tuning (anim-playback epic E2, 86ca2187g). Keyed by canonical anim name (must exist in `animations`). Fields (all optional): speedMultiplier (fraction of default frame RATE; 0.5 = half speed), dwellFrameIndex, dwellMs, finalDwellMs, playbackMode, startFrame/endFrame. Malformed values dropped + warned by scripts/build-sprite-manifest.mjs. Mirrors F02's slow-calm defaults; sponsor retunes on reload with zero gens (edit + npm run build + reload).
